prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: All of the following are safe laboratory practices except
A. maintaining an organized table.
B. wearing safety goggles during experiments.
C. mixing chemicals before reading instructions.
D. washing hands thoroughly after completing an experiment.
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
